decontamination_notes: Real feature from agronholm/anyio PR #1228, merged 2026-07-20, after model training cutoffs, so the specific implementation is novel. Repo sliced at the PR's base commit c384f99 (src/anyio + pyproject.toml + MIT LICENSE). Runs in the shared per-task image vulcanbench/sandbox:anyio-1191 (anyio's runtime deps preinstalled, anyio imported from the workspace via PYTHONPATH=src). Adds absolute-deadline timeout helpers fail_at() and move_on_at() alongside the existing delay-based fail_after()/move_on_after(). Hidden tests drive the public anyio API under anyio.run and assert observable timeout/cancel behavior; deadlines use anyio.current_time() with generous margins. Tests run with -c /dev/null so the repo's own pytest config/plugins are ignored.
